The external C sources of the Modelica Standard Library 3.2.3 (Modelica/Resources/C-Sources) are patched as follows:

1. const qualifiers in ModelicaStandardTables
The table and columns arguments of ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTimeTable_init, ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTimeTable_init2,
ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTable1D_init, ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTable1D_init2, ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTable2D_init
and ModelicaStandardTables_CombiTable2D_init2 are declared const (const double* table, const int* columns).
The code generated for Dynawo models is compiled in C++ and calls these functions with const arrays.

Warning: DYNModelicaOverridenFunctions.cpp copies the internal structures CombiTimeTable, CombiTable1D and CombiTable2D of
ModelicaStandardTables.c. They have to be checked if the version of the Modelica Standard Library is changed.
